Choose how Reels fit into your day, while keeping messages, profiles and ordinary browsing available.
Block detected Reels completely or set a daily allowance of 1–120 minutes. Pause protection whenever you want.
Detection and time tracking run on your device. No account, ads, analytics or internet permission.
ReelsGuard needs an Android accessibility service to recognize Reels and apply the protection you choose. Please review this before granting access.

Android accessibility can expose on-screen content. ReelsGuard inspects Instagram interface labels, view identifiers and element positions to identify the Reels viewer and its navigation button. Text exposed by Instagram may include private content; it is processed only transiently on your device and is not saved or transmitted.

When protection is enabled, the service performs Android’s Back action after confidently detecting a blocked Reels viewer. With a daily limit, it measures detected Reels viewing time and blocks after the allowance is used. If enabled, an accessibility overlay covers a confidently located Reels navigation button and prevents taps on that button when blocking applies.
Only your settings, consent and usage counters are stored. Screen content, messages, credentials and account information are not collected or stored. No accessibility content leaves the device.

This access is optional. You can decline, switch protection off, withdraw consent here or disable the service in Android settings at any time. ReelsGuard is a digital wellbeing tool, not an accessibility aid for disabilities.
The service is connected and your rules are enabled. Detection depends on Instagram’s interface.

Service connected. Android accessibility access is enabled.
In Android Settings, find ReelsGuard under downloaded or installed accessibility apps, enable its service and return here. Then turn on protection on the dashboard.

The optional cover uses the accessibility service’s overlay permission. A separate “Display over other apps” permission is not needed. It only appears over a confidently located Instagram Reels navigation button when blocking applies.

If Android restricts a sideloaded app’s accessibility access, consult the installation guide before allowing restricted settings. If the service stays disconnected, switch it off and on in Android settings. Availability varies by Android version.
Cover and disable taps on the identified button when blocking applies. This does not remove it from Instagram. If it cannot be located safely, no cover is shown.
Language and light or dark appearance follow your device settings. English is the fallback language.
This turns off protection and stops screen inspection, time tracking and button covering. To remove Android accessibility access as well, disable ReelsGuard in Android settings.
ReelsGuard works locally. There is no backend, account, internet permission, advertising or analytics SDK. Your settings and usage counters stay in this app’s local storage.

The accessibility service transiently inspects Instagram’s exposed interface to recognize Reels. It does not save screen content or collect messages, credentials, browsing content or account information. It never transmits accessibility content.

Accessibility access enables deterministic Back actions and a narrowly positioned button cover. ReelsGuard does not change Instagram’s APK or files, require root, or request a separate overlay permission.

You control access. Turn protection off on the dashboard, withdraw consent in Settings, or disable the service in Android settings. Clear the app’s storage or uninstall it to remove locally stored settings and counters. ReelsGuard never prevents disabling or uninstalling it.
ReelsGuard is an open-source digital wellbeing app for Android. It helps you reduce Instagram Reels viewing while leaving the rest of Instagram available.
Licensed under the MIT License. Source code, installation instructions, testing guidance and known limitations are provided with this project.
ReelsGuard is independent of Instagram and Meta. Instagram is a trademark of its respective owner.

Protection is best effort. Instagram may change its interface or hide accessibility information. Uncertain screens are left alone to protect normal browsing. Compatibility requires testing on your device and Instagram version.

Recognizes Instagram Reels, applies your chosen blocking or daily time limit, and optionally covers the Reels navigation button. Screen content stays on your device and is not stored. Enable only after reviewing and accepting the in-app disclosure.
Settings or usage could not be read or saved, so protection is paused. Restart ReelsGuard and check available storage. Your allowance has not been reset.
